name: whiteoutlib
description: C++20 library for parsing & writing Blizzard model and texture formats (MDX, M2, M3, BLP, DDS, …), plus CASC and MPQ storage backends.

textures.description: Build whiteout_textures: BLP, DDS, TEX, PNG, JPEG, TGA, TIFF, BMP and the other texture formats, the BCn codecs and the PBR bake.

models.description: Build whiteout_models (MDX/MDL, M2, WMO, M3, glTF, FBX, OBJ and the Diablo III model reader) and the WEM core, whiteout_wem.

wem-convert.description: Build whiteout_wem_convert: the converters between WEM and every model format, and the export passes.

wem-edit.description: Build whiteout_wem_edit: modelling, retopology, fracture, UV, rigging, skinning, and physics simulation and its bakes.

zlib-ng.description: Use zlib-ng as the DEFLATE backend (faster compression/decompression; adds a zlib-ng dependency). Without this feature the dependency-free built-in codec is used.

casc.description: Enable CASC archive support (Blizzard's modern format used by WoW, Diablo III/IV, StarCraft II, …)

mpq.description: Enable MPQ archive support (Blizzard's legacy format used by Warcraft III, classic WoW, …)

database.description: Enable WoW client database support (DBC and DB2 tables, WDBC through WDC5)

curl.description: Use libcurl as SimpleHttpHandler's transport on non-Windows hosts (Windows uses WinHTTP unconditionally).
